moreover.ex: The cake is tasty. Moreover, it has fruit.

ours.def: the thing that belongs to us

parade.def: a line of people, bands and floats moving along a street

perceive.def: to notice or understand with your senses

preliminary.ex: A preliminary race happens before the final.

premiere.def: the first time a film or show is shown

presidency.def: the job of leading a country
presidency.ex: The presidency lasts four years in some countries.

react.def: to do something because of what happened

realistic.def: looking just like it does in life
realistic.ex: The painting of the fish is realistic.

remark.def: words you say about something you notice

retain.def: to keep or hold on to

satisfaction.def: a happy feeling when you have what you wanted

scratch.def: to rub or scrape with something sharp

shade.def: a cool place out of the sun

sheriff.def: a person who keeps order in a county

sometime.def: at a time not yet decided

thou.def: an old word that means you

tier.def: one level in a set of levels

yield.ex: Cars yield to people crossing the road.

accomplish.def: to finish something you set out to do

cattle.def: cows and bulls kept on a farm

convenient.def: easy to use or close by

eliminate.ex: We eliminate litter from the beach.

embarrass.def: to make someone feel shy and uncomfortable

harbor.def: a safe place by the shore where boats stay
